## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List commands and manual checks actually performed, with outcomes and limitations. Distinguish baseline failures from regressions.

## Compatibility and documentation

Note API/event/schema changes, matching client/backend work, migration risks, and documentation updates. State when none apply.

- [ ] I kept the change focused and reviewed the diff for secrets and personal data.
- [ ] I documented relevant validation results and unresolved failures.

Do not include private vulnerability details; follow SECURITY.md.
